title: Premium Accounting Schedule for Whole Life Insurance: Policy Fee, Modal Factors and Remittance Tolerances
content:
**Product:** Whole Life Insurance, all six Ashgrove tiers.

The annual premium of a Whole Life Insurance policy includes a flat annual policy fee. An installment is the annual premium multiplied by the modal factor of the premium mode. Remittances are measured against the shortage tolerance and the overpayment refund threshold below, and the monthly EFT privilege is governed by the returned-draft limit, the re-enrollment wait and the latest draft day.

## Annual policy fee (USD per policy year, included in the annual premium)

| Tier | Annual policy fee |
|---|---|
| Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life | 36.00 |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100 | 75.00 |
| Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 65 | 75.00 |
| Ashgrove 20-Pay Whole Life | 75.00 |
| Ashgrove 10-Pay Whole Life | 75.00 |
| Ashgrove Single Premium Whole Life | 0.00 |

## Modal factors (multiplier of the annual premium for each installment)

The same factors apply on every tier.

| Premium mode | Modal factor | Installments in a policy year |
|---|---|---|
| Annual | 1.0 | 1 |
| Semiannual | 0.52 | 2 |
| Quarterly | 0.265 | 4 |
| Monthly EFT draft | 0.0875 | 12 |

## Remittance and EFT figures (identical on every tier)

| Figure | Value |
|---|---|
| Premium shortage tolerance: a shortfall up to this amount is applied as full payment of the installment | 2.00 USD |
| Overpayment refund threshold: unapplied money above this amount is refunded; at or below it, it is held toward the next installment | 25.00 USD |
| Returned EFT drafts within a rolling 12 months that end the EFT privilege | 2 |
| Wait before monthly EFT may be elected again after the privilege ended | 6 calendar months |
| Latest day of the month that may be chosen as the EFT draft day | 28 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- **Installments of one annual premium.** On an annual premium of 1000.00 dollars, the annual installment is 1000.00, each semiannual installment 520.00 (0.52 of it), each quarterly installment 265.00 (0.265 of it) and each monthly EFT draft 87.50 (0.0875 of it).
- **Shortage tolerance on both sides.** Against an installment of 265.00, a remittance of 263.00 falls short by exactly 2.00 and is applied as full payment; a remittance of 262.99 falls short by 2.01 and is not.
- **Refund threshold on both sides.** Unapplied money of exactly 25.00 is held toward the next installment; 25.01 is refunded.
- **Draft day.** Day 28 may be chosen as the monthly draft day; day 29, 30 or 31 may not.
